timeline.title: 腾讯混元Hy4模型权重开源
timeline.title_en: Tencent Hunyuan Hy4 Model Weights Open-Sourced
timeline.what_it_does: 腾讯将其旗舰多模态大模型混元Hy4的权重开源，允许开发者下载并自行部署，支持文本、图像和视频理解，以及计算机控制能力。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Tencent open-sourced the weights of its flagship multimodal large model, Hunyuan Hy4, allowing developers to download and deploy it themselves. It supports text, image, and video understanding, as well as computer control capabilities.
timeline.who_cares: 希望在本地部署或定制顶级多模态AI模型的开发者、研究人员和企业。
timeline.limitations: 模型参数量达7700亿，需要强大的多GPU集群才能自托管（FP8精度下需超过700GB内存）。虽然开源，但商业使用前需仔细核查腾讯的许可条款。
timeline.limitations_en: With 770 billion parameters, self-hosting requires a powerful multi-GPU cluster (over 700GB memory for FP8). While open-source, commercial use requires careful review of Tencent's licensing terms.
